upgrade.elementals.gasCloud.description: Releases a cloud of gas around you, inflicting Nausea and Slowness on nearby enemies.
upgrade.elementals.gasCloudSizeI.descrip: Increases Gas Cloud radius by +0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.gasCloudSizeII.descri: Increases Gas Cloud radius by another +0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.gasVentI.description: Reduces Gas Cloud cooldown by 1 second.
upgrade.elementals.gasVentII.description: Reduces Gas Cloud cooldown by another 1 second.
upgrade.elementals.gasSuffocate.descript: Instantly suffocates enemies inside the gas radius, dealing magic burst damage.
upgrade.elementals.gasSuffocateDamageI.d: Increases suffocation burst damage by +1.5 HP.
Increases suffocation burst damage by another +1.5 HP.
upgrade.elementals.gasLeak.description: Leaves a lingering toxic cloud that poisons enemies and spoils farmland/grass underneath.
upgrade.elementals.gasLeakDurationI.desc: Increases toxic cloud duration by +5 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.gasIgnite.description: Ignites the surrounding gas, setting enemies and the ground on fire in a violent explosion.
upgrade.elementals.gasJet.description: Propels yourself backward or upward using a strong blast of compressed gas, disorienting anyone near the nozzle.
upgrade.elementals.gasJetForceI.descript: Increases propulsion force of Gas Jet.
upgrade.elementals.gasMiasma.description: Releases a dense, debilitating fog that afflicts target entities with Blindness and Weakness.
upgrade.elementals.gasMiasmaRadiusI.desc: Increases Miasma effect radius by 1.5 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.gasCorrosiveMist.desc: Emits an acidic vapor that damages enemies and erodes armor durability over time.
upgrade.elementals.echoingVoice.descript: Unleash an amplified shout in a cone in front of you. Anyone caught in it takes sound damage, gets knocked back, is stunned for a couple seconds, and has any fire on them extinguished.
upgrade.elementals.resonantPulse.descrip: Release a sphere of echoing sound around you that passes straight through walls. Every living creature caught in it glows for several seconds, revealing its position even behind blocks.
upgrade.elementals.sonicShockwave.descri: Release a shockwave of pure sound around you, knocking back and damaging every living thing nearby.
upgrade.elementals.sonicShockwaveRadiusI: Increases the radius of Sonic Shockwave by 1.5 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.sonicShockwaveCooldow: Reduces the cooldown of Sonic Shockwave by 1.5 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.sonicShockwaveDisorie: Anyone caught in Sonic Shockwave is also afflicted with Nausea.
upgrade.elementals.resonancePulse.descri: Fire a resonant frequency ahead of you, shattering fragile blocks like glass and ice and afflicting Nausea on anyone caught near the impact.
upgrade.elementals.resonancePulseRadiusI: Increases the impact radius of Resonance Pulse by 1 block.
upgrade.elementals.silenceField.descript: Toggle a field of muffled sound around you. Enemies who enter it are afflicted with Slowness for as long as they remain inside.
upgrade.elementals.silenceFieldRadiusI.d: Increases the radius of Silence Field by 2 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.sonicStep.description: Propel yourself quickly in the direction you're looking, riding a burst of sound. Stops just short of any solid obstacle.
upgrade.elementals.sonicStepDistanceI.de: Increases the distance of Sonic Step by 2 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.sonicStepCooldownI.de: Reduces the cooldown of Sonic Step by 0.8 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.discordantScream.desc: Aim at a single target in your line of sight and unleash a discordant scream, afflicting them with Weakness and Slowness.
upgrade.elementals.discordantScreamRange: Increases the range of Discordant Scream by 4 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.discordantScreamDurat: Doubles the duration of Discordant Scream's effects.
upgrade.elementals.echoSense.description: Toggle a passive echolocation pulse. While active, the position of nearby living creatures is periodically revealed to you with particles, even behind walls.
upgrade.elementals.echoSenseRadiusI.desc: Increases the radius of Echo Sense by 6 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.totalZero.description: Release a burst of absolute cold around you. Anyone caught in it takes freezing damage, is heavily slowed, has any fire on them extinguished, and starts icing over. Nearby water freezes into ice.
upgrade.elementals.scorchingWave.descrip: Release a wave of extreme heat around you. Anyone caught in it takes fire damage, is set ablaze, and has any accumulated freezing thawed out. You gain brief Fire Resistance, and nearby ice and snow melt away.
upgrade.elementals.voidBall.description: Aim at a point and tear open a vacuum implosion there. Anything nearby is pulled toward the center, and anyone close enough to it is crushed for damage.
upgrade.elementals.voidStep.description: Step through the void, blinking forward in the direction you're looking, stopping just short of any solid obstacle.
upgrade.elementals.mudSurge.description: Sends a wave of mud in the direction you're looking, slowing anyone caught in it.
upgrade.elementals.mudTrap.description: Traces a line of mud toward your target, dragging them underground where they'll suffocate. Hold crouch to keep them trapped.
upgrade.elementals.mudBall.description: Hurls a ball of mud that bursts on impact, coating everyone caught nearby in Slowness and Mining Fatigue.
upgrade.elementals.mudSpikes.description: Erupts a cluster of jagged mud spikes from the ground where you're aiming, damaging and launching anyone caught in the burst upward.
upgrade.elementals.crystalShard.descript: Fires a spike of crystal in the direction you're looking, dealing damage to whatever it hits.
upgrade.elementals.crystalSpike.descript: Erupts a cluster of jagged amethyst spikes from the ground where you're aiming, damaging and launching anyone caught in the burst upward.
upgrade.elementals.crystalWall.descripti: Raises a temporary wall of crystal in front of you, blocking arrows and movement for a short while before it shatters away.
upgrade.elementals.crystalPrison.descrip: Strikes your target and encases them in a cage of solid crystal, stunning them in place for several seconds before it shatters.
upgrade.elementals.crystalStep.descripti: Shatter into crystal shards and reform a short distance ahead, in the direction you're looking. Won't trigger if the destination isn't clear.
upgrade.elementals.crystalArmor.descript: Coat yourself in a shell of hardened crystal plates while holding crouch, granting resistance to incoming damage.
upgrade.elementals.crystalMastery.descri: Passive. Once bought, permanently strengthens your Crystal Shards (more shards per volley) and Crystal Spikes (larger, more damaging eruption).
upgrade.elementals.boneControl.descripti: Seizes a living creature by its skeleton and lets you freely hoist it up/down, side to side, and closer/further with your aim and scroll wheel, like a telekinetic pickup, then hurl it at will.
upgrade.elementals.bonePuppeteer.descrip: Targets a living creature. A true undead (Skeleton, Zombie, Wither Skeleton, and the like) is puppeted outright, forced to walk wherever you're looking with its own AI switched off for a few seconds. Anything else -- players included -- has its bones seized instead, locking it in place with heavy Slowness and Weakness for a moment.
upgrade.elementals.sandTornado.descripti: Whips up a spinning column of sand where you're aiming, sucking in nearby sand blocks and dragging, blinding, and battering anyone caught inside. Hold crouch to keep it going.
upgrade.elementals.sandBlast.description: Flings a stinging jet of sand at whoever you're aiming at, dealing damage and blinding them with grit in the eyes.
upgrade.elementals.sandQuicksand.descrip: Turns a patch of sandy ground where you're aiming into real quicksand for a while. Anyone who steps in it sinks partway and struggles against heavy Slowness and Weakness until it settles back down.
upgrade.elementals.sandWave.description: Surf a wave of loose sand out from under your feet, launching you forward with a burst of Speed and Slow Falling. Only works while standing on sand, red sand, or gravel.
upgrade.elementals.glassShards.descripti: Fires a shard of glass in the direction you're looking, dealing damage to whatever it hits.
upgrade.elementals.glassShardsDamageI.de: Increases the damage of Glass Shards by 1.
upgrade.elementals.glassShardsDamageII.d: Increases the damage of Glass Shards by another 1.
upgrade.elementals.glassShardsSpeedI.des: Increases the flight speed of Glass Shards, making them harder to dodge.
upgrade.elementals.glassSpray.descriptio: Shatters a handful of glass toward the direction you're looking, spraying a wide cone of weaker shards to cover an area instead of a single target.
upgrade.elementals.glassSprayWideI.descr: Sprays more shards in a wider cone.
upgrade.elementals.glassArmor.descriptio: Encases you in a thin shell of glass that absorbs part of the damage from the next hit you take before shattering. Toggle it off manually to cancel without shattering.
upgrade.elementals.glassArmorShatterI.de: When Glass Armor shatters, the shards fly back at your attacker, dealing extra damage and briefly slowing them.
upgrade.elementals.lavaPool.description: Melts the ground where you're aiming into a pool of real lava. Cools into basalt after a while.
upgrade.elementals.lavaJet.description: Fires a jet of molten lava in a straight line, dealing damage, setting whatever it hits on fire, and knocking it back.
upgrade.elementals.magmaSpike.descriptio: Erupts a cluster of magma spikes from the ground where you're aiming, damaging and launching anyone caught in the blast before the spikes sink back down.
upgrade.elementals.lavaShuriken.descript: Summons a shard of molten lava that hovers and follows your aim. Left-click to hurl it forward, dealing heavy damage and turning any water it passes through into obsidian.
upgrade.elementals.lavaSurf.description: Summon a real wave of molten lava beneath your feet while sprinting, carrying you forward with speed and fire immunity, and taking no fall damage when you dismount.
upgrade.elementals.lavaFlow.description: Unleashes a massive river of molten lava from your feet, surging forward and widening as it flows across a large area, melting through snow and ice to reach the ground beneath, before cooling into basalt.
upgrade.elementals.volcanicEruption.desc: Erupts a small volcano where you're aiming: a real lava core surrounded by a wide ring of magma spikes, dealing heavy damage and launching everyone caught in the blast.
upgrade.elementals.lavaGeyser.descriptio: Erupts a jet of molten lava from the ground beneath your target, launching them into the air, dealing damage, and setting them on fire.
upgrade.elementals.obsidianCrust.descrip: Instantly cools all lava within a short radius of you into solid obsidian, letting you cross lava fields or shut down enemy lava attacks. Permanent -- doesn't revert like Lava Pool or Magma Spike.
upgrade.elementals.metalSense.descriptio: Hold Shift to sense every living creature wearing real metal armor (iron, gold, chainmail, netherite) within range, making them glow through walls.
upgrade.elementals.chestplateDevelop.des: Gathers 3 iron ingots from your inventory and develops them into a real iron chestplate, equipping it instantly. Only works if your chest slot is empty.
upgrade.elementals.metalSlam.description: Yanks every nearby creature wearing real metal armor toward you, dealing damage and briefly slowing them. Anyone without metal armor is untouched.
upgrade.elementals.metalGrapple.descript: Fires a magnetic hook at whatever you're aiming at -- a real metal block or a creature wearing real metal armor -- and yanks YOU toward it. Pure mobility, deals no damage.
upgrade.elementals.metalShrapnel.descrip: Fires a metal shard that bursts on impact, damaging every living creature in a short radius. Creatures wearing real metal armor take extra damage from the shrapnel.
upgrade.elementals.metalRedirect.descrip: Grabs every arrow flying near you and redirects it at the nearest living creature, turning an incoming volley into a weapon against your enemies. Deals no damage on its own.
upgrade.elementals.metalCoil.description: Hold Shift while aiming at a creature wearing real metal armor to wrap it in magnetic coils, freezing its movement for as long as you hold the ability. Deals no damage.
upgrade.elementals.metalPlating.descript: Magnetically reinforces the real metal armor you're already wearing, granting temporary Resistance and Absorption. Requires at least one piece of real metal armor equipped.
upgrade.elementals.lightningSense.descri: Hold Shift to sense every conductive living creature (real metal armor, or soaked by water/rain) within range, making them glow through walls.
upgrade.elementals.lightningChainWhip.de: Strikes whatever you're aiming at, then arcs the shock to nearby conductive creatures, jumping up to 3 times. Damage weakens with every jump.
upgrade.elementals.thunderStep.descripti: Instantly teleports you in the direction you're looking, leaving a trail of sparks that damages anyone caught along the way.
upgrade.elementals.staticOvercharge.desc: Charges yourself with static electricity, granting temporary Speed and Haste.
upgrade.elementals.electroParalysis.desc: Hold Shift while aiming at a creature to lock it in place with a continuous shock for as long as you hold the ability. Conductive targets also take light damage over time.
upgrade.elementals.lightningRod.descript: Turns you into a living lightning rod -- a real bolt strikes your own position. You're immune to it, but everyone else nearby takes splash damage, and the strike refunds some of your chi.
upgrade.elementals.judgmentStrike.descri: Calls down a real, precise lightning bolt on whatever you're aiming at, guaranteeing the hit instead of relying on the vanilla bolt's random targeting. The costly culmination of mastering the storm.
upgrade.elementals.atmospherePressurePoi: Crushes the ground around the point you're standing on. Anyone caught inside is forced to crawl, and starts taking damage if they linger too long.
upgrade.elementals.pressureRadiusI.descr: Increases the radius of Pressure Point by 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.pressureRadiusII.desc: Increases the radius of Pressure Point by another 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.pressureDurationI.des: Increases the duration of Pressure Point by 3 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.pressureDurationII.de: Increases the duration of Pressure Point by another 3 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.atmosphericDome.descr: Surrounds you with a dome of compressed air. Deflects projectiles back at their source, pushes away anything nearby, and shatters light obstructions like leaves and webs. Hold crouch to maintain it.
upgrade.elementals.domeRadiusI.descripti: Increases the radius of Atmospheric Dome by 0.5 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.domeRadiusII.descript: Increases the radius of Atmospheric Dome by another 0.5 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.domeEfficiencyI.descr: Reduces the chi cost per tick of maintaining Atmospheric Dome, letting you hold it longer.
upgrade.elementals.domeEfficiencyII.desc: Reduces the chi cost per tick of maintaining Atmospheric Dome even further.
upgrade.elementals.pressureSlam.descript: Condenses the air in front of you into a focused strike, slamming a single target with concentrated pressure -- dealing damage, driving them into the ground, and leaving them briefly Weakened.
upgrade.elementals.pressureSlamDamageI.d: Increases the damage of Pressure Slam by 1.5.
Increases the damage of Pressure Slam by another 1.5.
upgrade.elementals.pressureSlamCooldownI: Reduces the cooldown of Pressure Slam by 1 second.
upgrade.elementals.updraft.description: Summons a column of low pressure beneath you, launching you upward and granting brief Slow Falling so you can come back down safely.
upgrade.elementals.updraftHeightI.descri: Increases the upward velocity of Updraft.
upgrade.elementals.updraftHeightII.descr: Increases the upward velocity of Updraft even further.
upgrade.elementals.updraftCooldownI.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Updraft by 1.5 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.mistCloud.description: Plants a thick fog around you that lingers for a while, blinding and disorienting everyone caught inside. You are never affected by your own fog.
upgrade.elementals.mistCloudSizeI.descri: Increases the radius of Heavy Fog by 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.mistCloudSizeII.descr: Increases the radius of Heavy Fog by another 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.mistVentI.description: Reduces the cooldown of Heavy Fog by 1 second.
upgrade.elementals.mistVentII.descriptio: Reduces the cooldown of Heavy Fog by another 1 second.
upgrade.elementals.mistSpecialization.de: Choose a single path for your Heavy Fog: Choke, Veil, or Freeze. Only one can be active at a time.
upgrade.elementals.mistChoke.description: Your fog constantly damages everyone caught inside it. You are never harmed by your own fog.
upgrade.elementals.mistVeil.description: Your fog lingers for 5 extra seconds before dissipating.
upgrade.elementals.mistVeilDurationI.des: Increases the duration of your fog by another 5 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.mistFreeze.descriptio: Chills your fog, heavily slowing everyone caught inside it. You are never slowed by your own fog.
upgrade.elementals.noSpecialization: You haven't unlocked any specialization for this ability yet
upgrade.elementals.cycleSpecializationWr: You need to have Gas or Mist selected as your active element to cycle its specialization
upgrade.elementals.plasmaClaws.descripti: Superheats the air around both your hands into blades of blue plasma. A short-range strike that scorches whatever it hits. If you're holding a tool or weapon, the plasma embeds itself into it instead, empowering the swing with the tool's own strength.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaReachI.descript: Increases the reach of Plasma Claws by 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaReachII.descrip: Increases the reach of Plasma Claws by another 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaHeatI.descripti: Reduces the cooldown of Plasma Claws by 6 ticks.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaHeatII.descript: Reduces the cooldown of Plasma Claws by another 6 ticks.
Choose a single path for your Plasma Claws: Sear, Flare, or Superheat. This choice is permanent.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaSear.descriptio: Your claws cut deeper, dealing extra raw damage on every strike.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaSearDamageII.de: Increases Sear's bonus damage by another 2.0.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaFlare.descripti: Sets whatever you strike ablaze for 3 seconds.
Increases the burn duration of Flare by another 2 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaSuperheat.descr: Your claws unleash overwhelming heat: deals bonus damage, guarantees a strong, long-lasting burn, and scorches anyone standing near your target.
upgrade.elementals.plasmaBlueFireSynergy: If you've mastered Blue Fire, Plasma Claws deals even more damage and burns with blue flame instead of ordinary fire.
upgrade.elementals.combustionExplosion.d: Hold cast to focus heat into a single point as you aim. Left-click to release an invisible bolt of condensed heat toward where you're looking, detonating on impact -- the shot itself can't be seen coming, only heard. Right-click to cancel the focus safely. Releasing too early or holding the focus too long risks detonating the blast in your own face instead.
upgrade.elementals.combustionChargeI.des: Reduces the minimum aim time of Combustion Blast.
upgrade.elementals.combustionChargeII.de: Reduces the minimum aim time of Combustion Blast even further.
upgrade.elementals.combustionPowerI.desc: Increases the damage and blast radius of Combustion Blast.
upgrade.elementals.combustionPowerII.des: Increases the damage and blast radius of Combustion Blast even further.
upgrade.elementals.combustionGuidance.de: Your Combustion Blast gently corrects its course toward your aim for a short time after being fired, letting the invisible bolt track a moving target instead of flying in a straight line.
upgrade.elementals.combustionVent.descri: Releases a short burst of scalding heat around your body, damaging and pushing away anyone nearby while giving yourself a quick burst of mobility away from danger.
upgrade.elementals.combustionSight.descr: Hold to channel your third eye's heat sense: grants yourself Night Vision and marks every living creature within range with a heat-signature glow, even through walls.
upgrade.elementals.combustionLance.descr: Hold to channel a visible, continuous beam of condensed heat at whatever you're aiming at, dealing steady burn damage. Safer than Combustion Blast -- no focus required, no self-damage risk -- but far lower damage per second.
upgrade.elementals.vineWhip.description: Lashes a vine at whatever you're aiming at. Hooks a living target and yanks them to you with a damaging strike, or if it only catches terrain, yanks you to that spot instead like a grappling hook.
upgrade.elementals.vineWall.description: Raises a temporary wall of foliage in front of you, blocking arrows and movement for a short while before it withers away.
upgrade.elementals.thornVolley.descripti: Fires a spray of poisoned thorns in the direction you're aiming. Each thorn that connects deals damage and leaves a short-lived Poison behind.
upgrade.elementals.vineGrasp.description: Binds a living target in vines and lets you puppet it while you hold the key: drag it toward wherever you're looking, look sharply upward to hoist it into the air, or crouch to slam it down and crush it. Left-click to hurl it away, right-click to simply let go.
upgrade.elementals.rootSnare.description: Roots erupt from the ground around you, entangling every living creature nearby and pinning them almost in place for a few seconds.
upgrade.elementals.purifyingWater.descri: Blesses a body of water in front of you for a short while. Skeletons, husks, blazes, and baby zombies caught in it glow and dissolve into spirit dust. Witches, pillagers, vindicators, and baby zombie villagers are cleansed back into ordinary villagers, cracked iron golems are fully repaired, and a wither skeleton is purified into a snow golem.
upgrade.elementals.curseMinion.descripti: Curses whatever creature you're aiming at. For a short while, it stops attacking you and turns on the nearest other mobs and players instead.
upgrade.elementals.bloodVeinLock.descrip: Reach out and lock your target's veins and joints from a distance, afflicting heavy Slowness and Mining Fatigue for several seconds. Lasts longer and hits harder at night.
upgrade.elementals.bloodForcedGrasp.desc: Seizes your target's hand tendons at range, forcing their fingers open and knocking whatever they're holding out of their grip. No damage, pure disarm.
upgrade.elementals.bloodTwinShot.descrip: Fires two Blood Shot projectiles at once in a narrow spread, each carrying your active effects onto whoever it strikes.
upgrade.elementals.bloodMarkedVein.descr: Pinpoints a vessel in your target from a distance, revealing their position through walls with Glowing and weakening their muscles for a few seconds.
upgrade.elementals.bloodRush.description: Surges your own circulation while you hold Shift, granting continuous Speed and Jump Boost for as long as you can keep it up.
Only usable while Overcharged. Draws on that surplus to numb your body against pain, granting brief Resistance and Absorption.
upgrade.elementals.bloodWideGrasp.descri: Widens the reach of your Blood Bag's paralysis, letting you lock down targets from further away.
upgrade.elementals.bloodPickup.descripti: Seizes a target and holds them locked to your aim while you channel, stacking heavy Weakness, Slowness, and Mining Fatigue. Left-click yanks them in, right-click lets go.
upgrade.elementals.bloodPickupSwarm.desc: Passive. Once bought, Pickup can hold up to 5 targets at once, arranged in a small ring around your aim. Press Pickup's key again while channeling to grab another target instead of restarting.
upgrade.elementals.bloodFreeGrip.descrip: Passive. Left-click while channeling Pickup now hurls every held target away from you and releases them, instead of yanking them closer. You're also no longer rooted in place while channeling.
